about: One request in an Area Note passes. A stray write changes another line in that request note; act puts it back, so a second check is due. Before the second check, a further stray write adds a line to the same note (simulated with a copy step between act and the second check). The second check flags it as unexplained-change. close lists it under 'Still flagged after the second check', with its rule, its note, and the added line, and edits nothing: the added line is still in the note after close, because act never runs on second-check flags.
